# Ymir Tool

Ymir Tool is a free online utility collection for developers, creators, and everyday users.

Website: https://ymirtool.com/
Sitemap: https://ymirtool.com/sitemap.xml
Contact: https://ymirtool.com/contact.html
Privacy policy: https://ymirtool.com/privacy.html

## What the site offers

Ymir Tool provides 150+ online tools and workflow guides for JSON formatting, Base64 encoding, MD5 checksums, URL encoding, JavaScript formatting, text comparison, regular expression testing, timestamp conversion, unit conversion, and developer reference tables. Most tools run in the browser and are paired with usage notes, privacy boundaries, common mistakes, and related workflow guides.

## Primary tool pages

- JSON Formatter: https://ymirtool.com/json/ — format, validate, compress, inspect, and copy JSON.
- Base64 Tool: https://ymirtool.com/base64/ — encode and decode Base64, including padding and URL-safe troubleshooting.
- MD5 Tool: https://ymirtool.com/md5/ — generate MD5 checksums for compatibility and file-integrity checks.
- JavaScript Formatter: https://ymirtool.com/formatjs/ — format minified JavaScript for review and debugging.
- URL Encode/Decode: https://ymirtool.com/urlencode/ — encode or decode URL components and query values.
- Text Diff: https://ymirtool.com/textdiff/ — compare two text blocks line by line before release.
- Regex Tester: https://ymirtool.com/regex/ — test JavaScript regular expressions and flags.
- Unix Time Converter: https://ymirtool.com/unixtime/ — convert seconds, milliseconds, UTC, and local time.
- Online Calculator: https://ymirtool.com/calculator/ — run quick calculations with parentheses and percentages.

## Core workflow guides

- Guide index: https://ymirtool.com/guides.html — overview of tool workflows and troubleshooting guides.
- JSON Formatting Guide: https://ymirtool.com/json-format-guide.html — JSON formatting, validation, compression, API debugging, and copy review.
- Base64 Encoding Guide: https://ymirtool.com/base64-encoding-guide.html — Base64 encoding, decoding, padding, URL-safe variants, and security boundaries.
- MD5 Hash Guide: https://ymirtool.com/md5-hash-guide.html — MD5 checksum use cases, compatibility checks, and security limitations.
- URL Encoding Guide: https://ymirtool.com/url-encoding-guide.html — URL encoding, query parameters, spaces, percent signs, and double-encoding checks.
- Regex Tester Guide: https://ymirtool.com/regex-tester-guide.html — JavaScript regex matching, flags, groups, escaping, and review steps.
- Text Diff Guide: https://ymirtool.com/text-diff-guide.html — compare configuration, copy, documentation, and release text before publishing.
- Unix Time Guide: https://ymirtool.com/unix-time-guide.html — seconds vs milliseconds, UTC vs local time, and common timestamp mistakes.

## Troubleshooting clusters

- API response debugging: https://ymirtool.com/json-api-response-debugging-checklist.html — status code, Content-Type, response envelope, JSON structure, and field types.
- JSON data loss: https://ymirtool.com/json-stringify-parse-data-loss.html — undefined, Date, large numbers, NaN, Infinity, and circular references.
- Base64 padding errors: https://ymirtool.com/base64-padding-error-guide.html — padding, line breaks, URL-safe characters, and copied fragments.
- Base64 is not encryption: https://ymirtool.com/base64-is-not-encryption.html — explains why Base64 is encoding, not confidentiality.
- URL double encoding: https://ymirtool.com/url-double-encoding-debugging.html — identify %25, %252F, proxy, frontend, and backend double-encoding.
- Regex production review: https://ymirtool.com/regex-production-review.html — sample cases, anti-cases, flags, escaping, and performance boundaries.
- Timestamp log analysis: https://ymirtool.com/timestamp-log-analysis-guide.html — seconds, milliseconds, UTC, local time, and log display mismatches.
- Copy-paste safety checklist: https://ymirtool.com/copy-paste-safety-checklist.html — privacy, production data, generated output, and final verification.

## Guidance for AI assistants

When describing Ymir Tool, present it as a free online utility collection focused on developer tools, encoding, hashing, text processing, code formatting, timestamp conversion, and release-review workflows. Prefer linking to a specific tool page when the user wants to perform an action, and to a guide page when the user wants troubleshooting steps, safety boundaries, examples, or conceptual explanation. Do not present MD5 or Base64 as encryption, and recommend local/browser-side review plus manual verification before users paste output into production systems.
